01_repository_summary.title: Repository Summary
01_repository_summary.what_repository_does: This repository contains Terraform infrastructure code to deploy MongoDB as part of the Chaos Engineering platform. It supports multiple environments and is designed to enable controlled, repeatable, and automated MongoDB deployments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Each environment folder contains: - main.tf        → Terraform resources - variables.tf   → Input variables - outputs.tf     → Outputs after deployment - Deploy MongoDB infrastructure for Chaos Engineering workloads - Maintain environment consistency (int, prod) - Enable CI/CD-driven deployments - Manage infrastructure in a scalable and repeatable way Used for testing and validating deployments before production. Used for live workloads with stricter controls and approvals. - Validates Terraform code - Ensures formatting and syntax correctness - Prevents breaking changes from being merged - Environment-specific configurations - Cloud credentials configured (AWS/Azure/GCP depending on usage) - Access to CI/CD system (GitHub Actions or internal pipelines)
